def: OpenAI's 175-billion-parameter language model, described in 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners' (Brown et al., 2020), which performed new tasks from examples in the prompt without fine-tuning.
practice: It made in-context learning and prompting the main way to use language models; ChatGPT launched about two and a half years later on a fine-tuned model from the GPT-3.5 series.
